youtube_description:
Businesses across North Texas are desperate to hire people; meanwhile, people across our community are looking for jobs, new careers, opportunities to advance, and higher pay.

To bridge this gap, we’re holding a North Texas Job Fair at the Irving Convention Center on Monday, August 7th from 11 AM - 3PM! We’ll have 375 businesses with 15,000 job openings at this FREE event – all under one roof! 

Sign up today at www.myNTXjobs.com
